name: Delta Electronics
summary: Established in 1971 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Delta Electronics, Inc. is a global leader specializing in power and thermal management solutions. Its extensive operations span Mainland China, the United States, Taiwan, and various international markets, organized into three primary divisions: Power Electronics, Automation, and Infrastructure. The Power Electronics division supplies a broad array of components, including inductors, transformers, networking devices, EMI filters, solenoids, and current sensing resistors, catering to applications in portable electronics, cloud computing, automotive systems, and the Internet of Things (IoT). It also manufactures diverse power supply units, such as switching power supplies, power modules, external adapters, and specialized power solutions for industrial and medical sectors, alongside industrial battery charging products. This segment further delivers comprehensive thermal management items like DC brushless fans, blowers, motors, cabinet thermal solutions, and ventilation/automotive fans. A core area of expertise is automotive electronics, encompassing full EV/HEV powertrain solutions, on-board chargers, DC/DC converters, traction inverters and motors, and both merchant and mobile power products. Within the Automation division, Delta offers a wide suite of industrial automation products and integrated solutions. These comprise drives, motion control systems, industrial control and communication devices, power quality enhancement tools, human-machine interfaces (HMIs), sensors, meters, and advanced robotic solutions. It also develops crucial information monitoring and management systems like SCADA and industrial EMS to enable smart manufacturing processes. Beyond industrial applications, this segment extends to building automation, providing management software, control systems, high-efficiency LED drivers and luminaires for smart lighting, and intelligent video surveillance technologies. The Infrastructure division focuses on essential systems such as telecommunications power systems, networking infrastructure, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and data center solutions. Furthermore, it addresses modern energy demands with EV charging products, energy storage systems, renewable energy solutions, and motor drives.
